newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to find resistance at 128.62.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to find resistance at 128.62.

text.p: June notionnel futures traded on MATIF have held above support at 128.04, 08 over the last couple of weeks but have made little upside progress and will have to tackle resistance at 128.62 on Tuesday, technical analysts said.
"Notionnel has seen quite a lot of resistance at 128.62 which is a Fibonacci level and yesterday's high," said Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London.

"Obviously that is quite a barrier and it has to be cleared to signal a test of the next resistance at 128.94. I would be tending to look for gains to be capped and then for notionnel to drift back again," she said.
At 0816 GMT, June notionnel futures were at 128.48, up 16 basis points on the day.
The 128.62 level is a 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement of the recent slide from 128.94 on April 24 to 128.10 on April 25.
Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking here, said notionnel futures had held up well in recent sessions keeping above support levels at 128.24 and 128.04,08.

"Those two levels have held the market up well...but they are not making a lot of progress on the upside," he said. "Initial resistance is at 128.54, but probably the more important level is the 128.72/76 level."

Above that area Ostwald saw further resistance at 129.04, the high on April 15, but he said notionnel would be looking to Bunds for a lead and he did not see them getting so high during this session. To the downside Whitby saw first support between 128.50 and 128.38. Those levels were the low so far this session and a high late on Monday near to the close.
"There was a gap left there this morning too and I'm looking for that to be filled," Whitby said. "Below that 128.22, yesterday's low, will come under pressure later on."
June Pibor futures were at 96.37, up 0.04 on the day.
